_comment: Proof of Dev ship-report hook. Merge this "hooks" block into .claude/settings.json (project) or ~/.claude/settings.json (global). Adjust the script path if the claude-vesting skill is installed somewhere other than ~/.claude/skills/. The hook reports `git push` Bash calls to the Proof of Dev API as ship signals (never moves money) and always exits 0 — it cannot block or break a push. Optional env: POD_API_URL (default https://api.proofofdev.xyz), POD_GITHUB_LOGIN (your GitHub login, sent as authorLogin).
